exposure: Coping styles (planning, acceptance, humor, instrumental support, venting, denial)
Stress coping styles (measured using the Brief COPE)
cohort: 146 pregnant women in New Orleans, LA and Baton Rouge, LA, during or immediately after Hurricane Katrina
finding: Hurricane exposure was significantly associated with induction of labor and current perceived stress, while stress perception was significantly associated with pregnancy-induced hypertension and gestational diabetes.
cross-section timing: During or immediately after Hurricane Katrina
